rows.name: Dissolve
rows.text: The welcome fades into the menu; each leaf fades as it falls, the far ones first.

rows.name: Lift
rows.text: The card floats up and away while the leaves are let go and drop out of view.

rows.name: Step inside
rows.text: You step through the leaves: the card opens toward you and the leaves brush past.

rows.name: Curtain
rows.text: The cream drops like a curtain with a row of leaves tumbling along its edge.

rows.name: Gust
rows.text: A gust from the left blows the leaves off the screen, tumbling, and pulls the cream with them.

rows.name: Homecoming
rows.text: The logo flies home to the top of the menu; the leaves swirl after it in its wake.

rows.name: Tip back
rows.text: The leaves settle at the bottom, then the welcome card tips back and lies down flat.

rows.name: Storm
rows.text: A flurry of big leaves fills the screen, then the wind blows them apart onto the menu.

rows.name: Window
rows.text: The leaves gather into a wreath around a clearing that opens out to the edges.

rows.name: Scatter
rows.text: The welcome screen breaks into cream leaves that flutter away from your tap.

rows.name: Dissolve
rows.text: The welcome fades into the menu; each snowflake melts away on its own.

rows.name: Lift
rows.text: The card floats up; the warm air from inside carries the snow up and melts it.

rows.name: Step inside
rows.text: You step in from the snow: the flakes stream past you from the middle of the screen.

rows.name: Curtain
rows.text: The cream slides down like snow off a roof, dusting flakes from its snowy edge.

rows.name: Gust
rows.text: A gust of blowing snow streaks across the screen and sweeps the cream away.

rows.name: Homecoming
rows.text: The logo flies home to the top of the menu and lands in a soft puff of snow.

rows.name: Tip back
rows.text: The snow settles into a drift, then the welcome card tips back and lies down flat.

rows.name: Storm
rows.text: The snow thickens into a soft white-out, then clears onto the menu.

rows.name: Window
rows.text: The screen frosts over, then the frost recedes from the middle to the edges like a warming window.

rows.name: Scatter
rows.text: The welcome screen crystallises into ice tiles that fall away from your tap.

rows.name: Dissolve
rows.text: The welcome fades into the menu; each blossom closes softly and fades as it drifts down, the far ones first.

rows.name: Lift
rows.text: The card floats up; a spring breeze lifts the blossoms up and away with it.

rows.name: Step inside
rows.text: You step in under the blossoms: the card opens toward you and the blossoms float past on either side.

rows.name: Curtain
rows.text: The cream drops like a curtain with a garland of blossoms along its edge.

rows.name: Gust
rows.text: A spring breeze from the left carries the blossoms off, twirling, and pulls the cream away behind them.

rows.name: Homecoming
rows.text: The logo flies home to the top of the menu and lands in a little burst of blossoms.

rows.name: Tip back
rows.text: The blossoms settle along the bottom like fallen petals, then the welcome card tips back and lies down flat.

rows.name: Storm
rows.text: A shower of blossoms fills the screen, then the breeze scatters it onto the menu.

rows.name: Window
rows.text: The blossoms gather into a wreath around a clearing that opens out to the edges.

rows.name: Scatter
rows.text: The welcome screen breaks into cream petals that flutter away from your tap.

rows.name: Dissolve
rows.text: The welcome fades into the menu; the sunlight softens away and the seeds drift off on the breeze.

rows.name: Lift
rows.text: The card floats up; warm air carries the dandelion seeds up and out of view.

rows.name: Step inside
rows.text: You step in out of the sun: the card opens toward you and the seeds and sparkles drift past you.

rows.name: Curtain
rows.text: The cream lowers like a sunshade with sparkles on its edge while the sun sinks away; the menu shows from the top.

rows.name: Gust
rows.text: A warm breeze from the left blows the seeds across and sweeps the cream away with them.

rows.name: Homecoming
rows.text: The logo flies home to the top of the menu with sparkles in its wake while the sun sets.

rows.name: Tip back
rows.text: The seeds settle at the bottom, then the welcome card tips back into the warm light and lies down flat.

rows.name: Storm
rows.text: A cloud of dandelion seeds fills the screen, then the breeze blows it apart onto the menu.

rows.name: Window
rows.text: A ring of sparkling light opens a clearing in the middle that spreads out to the edges.

rows.name: Scatter
rows.text: The welcome screen breaks into cream shards, like rays of the sun, that fall away from your tap.
